news.title: DEA seizes 280 pounds of meth, fentanyl in multi-county drug bust
news.summary: A DEA raid near a Cobb County high school uncovered 7,000 grams of meth and led to federal charges against three suspects.

news.title: Atlanta Olympic Park Bombing | Former officer spent night standing over bomb remnants
news.summary: A former cop recalls protecting pipe bomb evidence during the 30th anniversary of the Atlanta Centennial Olympics.

news.title: Metro Atlanta masseuse jailed after 3-month investigation into inappropriately touching clients
news.summary: Police arrested Diange Cao after two women reported being inappropriately touched during massage sessions in Gwinnett County.

news.title: Homicide investigators ask for tips in cold case from 2000
news.summary: The Cartersville Police Department along with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation are investigating the brutal murder of 53-year-old Patricia Ann Hanlon.

news.title: Peachtree City company to pay $2.6M to settle fraud allegations, thanks to whistleblower
news.summary: A Peachtree City company has agreed to pay $2.6 million to settle allegations that it improperly obtained and received forgiveness for a Paycheck Protection Program loan.

news.title: Police search for Stockbridge McDonald's thief who stole $2,000
news.summary: Henry County police are searching for a suspect who walked into a Stockbridge McDonald's manager office and stole thousands of dollars.

news.title: Atlanta agency rejects state blame for South River fish kill
news.summary: An operational failure at an Atlanta wastewater facility caused an acidic chemical leak that killed more than 1,200 fish in the South River, state environmental investigators concluded.

news.summary: A hit-and-run crash in DeKalb County left a bicyclist seriously injured in the middle of the road early Monday morning.

news.summary: DeKalb County police announced on Saturday that Chase had been found.

news.title: Motorcyclist critically injured after crash on Ernest Barrett Pkwy
news.summary: A Saturday afternoon crash in Marietta left a motorcyclist fighting for life after separating from the bike on Ernest Barrett Parkway, police said.

news.title: Woman accused of murder following Douglasville domestic incident
news.summary: A domestic violence encounter in Douglasville turned deadly Thursday after a man died from severe injuries, according to authorities.

news.title: Detainee dies following cardiac arrest at Cobb County jail
news.summary: A 64-year-old detainee died at Kennestone Hospital after going into cardiac arrest while held at the Cobb County Adult Detention Center, law enforcement officials announced Monday.

news.title: Atlanta marks 30 years since Centennial Olympic Park bombing
news.summary: Monday marks 30 years since the deadly Centennial Olympic Park bombing shook Atlanta during the 1996 Summer Olympic Games, killing two people and injuring over 100 others.
